## Overview

A classic Tetris game built using Claude Code. This project demonstrates building an interactive browser-based game with smooth controls, scoring, and increasing difficulty.

The primary features of this app include:

- Classic Tetris gameplay with all 7 tetromino shapes
- Keyboard controls for movement, rotation, and fast drop
- Score tracking and level progression
- Responsive design that works on desktop browsers
